scope.purpose: Define allowed and prohibited store-listing claims and bind them to the final App Store and Google Play copy frozen by MOBILE-18.

allowed: skin-care product recommendations based on user-provided photo and survey context
morning and evening cosmetic skin-care routine guidance
skin diary and saved report features
prohibited: diagnoses acne or any disease or medical condition
treats, cures, or prevents a disease or medical condition
measures or clinically determines hydration, skin-barrier state, UV damage, or disease severity
claims dermatologist-equivalent, clinical, diagnostic, or treatment accuracy
claims a medical-device or regulated clinical function without external regulatory authority
claims guaranteed skin improvement or guaranteed product efficacy

finalCopyGate.check: Review final title, subtitle/short description, full description, screenshots, promotional text and feature graphics against this claim boundary before store submission.
